rollback_reason: No protected release with complete current premium-image, activation, source/media and isolated live delivery proof was established. The code baseline cannot substitute for such a release.
critical_change_rule: After an authorized freeze, any core/shared-hook/contract/source/engine change invalidates the prior readiness binding. Apply only with explicit critical-change authority and requalify the affected exact candidate through protected CI and applicable current live proofs.
resume_rule: Resolve recorded external gates without resetting exhausted proof attempts or accepted locks; bind actual engine/contract/source/proof/check identities to the same existing scheduled run and record an actual later freeze only when all mandatory gates pass.
